fonts.display: 'Aeonik Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Cream Paper
palette.role: Page canvas and section backgrounds — the entire site sits on this warm off-white like a notebook page

palette.name: Frost White
palette.role: Card surfaces, nav bar, input fields, and overlay panels — clean white layered on the cream canvas

palette.name: Chalk Gray
palette.role: Secondary surface for body backgrounds and subtle borders — barely-there differentiation from white

palette.name: Ice Wash
palette.role: Tinted blue-white for soft button hovers and highlight washes adjacent to the primary blue

palette.name: Notebook Pale
palette.role: Faint yellow-green tint used on selected/tagged surfaces for the play accent

palette.name: Charcoal Ink
palette.role: Primary text, all borders, icon strokes, and the offset shadow color — the universal line color, never pure black

palette.name: Pencil Gray
palette.role: Muted helper text, secondary borders, and disabled-state outlines

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Tertiary borders and dividers, low-emphasis UI rules

palette.name: Soft Silver
palette.role: Icon strokes and low-contrast border accents on illustration-adjacent elements

palette.name: Sky Crayon
palette.role: Primary action fills, nav accents, and the dominant chromatic surface — the only color loud enough to carry CTAs

palette.name: Canary Banner
palette.role: Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content.

palette.name: Duck Bill Orange
palette.role: Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Coral Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant — one slot in the rotating rainbow button-border system

palette.name: Peach Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Mint Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Lilac Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Lime Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Periwinkle Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Slate Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Marigold Sketch
palette.role: Outlined button border variant

palette.name: Wet Cement
palette.role: Decorative illustration stroke — water/sky blue outlines in duck and cloud drawings

palette.name: Peach Blush
palette.role: Soft warm tint for illustrated section backgrounds, never a UI control fill
